1.) Quentin uses the manuever from his .44 magnum. Jacko manuevers back
to close range. Jacko then strikes with Fast Hands to steal the .44
with First Strike. A press to continue is then played. Can Jacko use
the .44's manuever?

blood and effects still being successful. Can a disarmed vampire fail

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
bi...@scn.org wrote:
>
> A few questions came up last night, any comments?
>
> 1.) Quentin uses the manuever from his .44 magnum. Jacko manuevers back
> to close range. Jacko then strikes with Fast Hands to steal the .44
> with First Strike. A press to continue is then played. Can Jacko use
> the .44's manuever?

No. The .44 can only give one maneuver per combat.

> 2.) One of the group members had seen some posts here about failing to burn
> blood and effects still being successful. Can a disarmed vampire fail
> to burn 3 blood and remove the disarm?

No. If you fail to burn the blood, you fail to get the result.

Messages.Body:

"T.W.Malisch" <c62...@showme.missouri.edu> wrote:
> 1) Can Mummy's Tongue be directed at a vamp who is already tapped?

Yes.

> 2) Can an Inner Circle member become a justicar?
> (Thereby losing a vote, but gaining the ability to play
> Prince/Justicar cards)

Yes. (Any titled vampire can gain a new title - and give up the
old one - provided he meets the requirements of gaining the new
title).
